06600 r_cM LD A,RD_S:CALL COM_R
06610 CALL BAD?:POP BC:POP HL
06620 JR NZ,readr_er
06630 INC H:DJNZ readr_trk
06640 ;/* rd_side
06650 PUSH HL:PUSH BC
06660 LD A,(SD_F):DEC A
06670 JR Z,readr_nt
06680 LD HL,SIDE:LD A,(HL):CPL
06690 LD (HL),A:OR A
06700 JR Z,readr_nt
06710 CALL SDRS:POP BC:POP HL
06720 DEC C:RET Z
06730 JP readr_TRK
06740 readr_nt LD A,STPF
06750 CALL COM_R:LD HL,TRACK
06760 INC (HL):POP BC:POP HL
06770 DEC C:RET Z:JP readr_TRK
06780 readr_er LD A,(rrr):DEC A
06790 LD (rrr),A
06800 JR NZ,readr_trk
06810 LD A,(RERD):LD (rrr),A
06820 PUSH HL:PUSH BC
06830 CALL BIPER:CALL DRWN
06840 DB 7,7,12,4,7,2,22,8,9
06850 DM /DISK ERROR!/
06860 DB 22,10,8
06870 DM /RETRY  ABORT/
06880 DB #FF:CALL CRSR
06890 DB 5,7,1,1,1,9,1,1,2,0
06900 CALL BRLMS:LD A,(IX-6)
06910 DEC A:JP NZ,LMMS
06920 XOR A:LD C,#7F
06930 CALL OUTF:LD A,FIND
06940 CALL COM_R:LD A,(TRACK)
06950 LD C,#7F:CALL OUTF
06960 LD A,FIND:CALL COM_R
06970 CALL PAUS:POP BC:POP HL
06980 JP readr_trk

07010 LD (DRIV),A
07020 LD A,(LAST_SRS)
07030 LD C,#3F:CALL OUTF
07040 LD A,(FL_SAM):OR A
07050 JR NZ,str_in
07060 LD A,(LAST_DES)
07070 LD (LAST_SRS),A
07080 LD C,#3F:CALL OUTF
07090 CALL DRWN
07100 DB 7,7,13,3,0,5,22,8,8
07110 DM /Insert Sourse/
07120 DB 22,9,8
07130 DM /into drive /:DB #FF
07140 st_I LD A,(DRIV):ADD A,"A
07150 RST 16:CALL WAITK
07160 str_in EQU $
07170 CALL SDRS:CALL SET_P
07180 LD A,(TRACK):LD C,#7F
07190 CALL OUTF:LD A,FIND
07200 CALL COM_R:JP D_I+3
07210 ;

07230 LD (DRIV),A
07240 LD A,(LAST_DES)
07250 LD C,#3F:CALL OUTF
07260 LD A,(FL_SAM):OR A
07270 JR NZ,str_in
07280 LD A,(LAST_SRS)
07290 LD (LAST_DES),A
07300 LD C,#3F:CALL OUTF
07310 CALL DRWN
07320 DB 7,7,13,3,7,2,22,8,8
07330 DM /Insert Target/
07340 DB 22,9,8
07350 DM /into drive /:DB #FF
07360 JR st_I

07390 COPYWR  EQU $

07410       CALL NEXTVER
